items.title: Apple stockpiles inventory as it braces for ‘significant supply constraints’

items.title: Show HN: Gander, an Android file viewer that asks for no permissions at all
items.title_cn: Show HN: Gander ，一个Android文件查看器，完全不需要权限
items.summary: Hi HN, I built an Android file viewer that opens PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images, video, audio, Markdown and code, and asks for no permissions at all. I have always been uneasy about opening files people send me. On Android you either install a 400 MB office suite and sign in or use a small free viewer that wants storage access and ends up uploading your file to a server to render it. Also the hassle of having to download different apps for different file formats was really annoying. Gander
items.summary_cn: HN ，您好！我构建了一个Android文件查看器，可打开PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、图像、视频、音频、Markdown和代码，并要求完全没有权限。我一直对打开别人发给我的文件感到不安。在Android上，您可以安装一个400 MB的办公套件并登录，也可以使用一个需要存储访问权限的小型免费查看器，最终将文件上传到服务器进行渲染。此外，必须下载不同文件格式的不同应用程序的麻烦也非常令人讨厌。Gander
items.comment: 开源是好事，能不能用起来、改起来，才是衡量价值的标准。
